unverified_and_modelled.candidate_composition: Existing empirical conditional ticket composition; not server probabilities.

invariants: Each source occurrence generates one fixed candidate group and at most one actually claimable recruitment ticket.
An extra radio candidate never grants another ticket, free-reserve opportunity, formal recruit, corn-growth trigger or storage slot.
Choosing one candidate resolves the entire group; the remaining alternatives cannot be recruited or retained.
After selecting or retaining a ticket, preserve all previously rolled part/relic candidates and other recruitment groups.
Acquiring or losing radio after a candidate group was displayed must not regenerate that group.
A recorded observed count may override a specific battle's modelled count; it is not a reward-maximization parameter.
